0022600180.text: The Cavaliers (4-3) are on the road against the Oklahoma City Thunder (5-2) in Cleveland's eighth game of the season. Cleveland is 2nd in the Central, 2 games back, and 4th in the East, on a one-game losing streak with a 1-2 road record, while Oklahoma City is 2nd in the Northwest, 0.5 games back, and 4th in the West, on a one-game winning streak. Cleveland is without Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Peyton Watson (hamstring soreness), and Oklahoma City is missing Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee). The Cavaliers trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 117-112 loss in Cleveland on November 2, and they lost both meetings with Oklahoma City in 2025-26.
